avis.texte: This has been my go-to sunscreen for years. It is tinted but looks great whether my skin is a little tan in the summer or more fair in the winter. It is light and doesn’t cake up throughout the day. 46 SPF perfect for everyday coverage. I add a little bronzing drops if I want a little more color during the day. Stock up during Prime Day. BONUS* You can use your FSA/HSA dollars on this high quality sun protection and moisturizer in one.

avis.titre: One of the Best Zinc Sunscreens Out There
avis.texte: One of the Best Zinc Sunscreens Out There This is hands down one of the best facial sunscreens I’ve ever used. The formula is zinc-based, but unlike many others, it blends beautifully into the skin without leaving a white cast. The tint is incredibly versatile — I’ve had friends with very different skin tones try it, and it seems to adapt and look natural on everyone. The texture is lightweight and comfortable, not greasy or heavy, and it layers easily under makeup or can be worn on its own for a healthy, even look. I love that it offers strong mineral protection while still feeling elegant and easy to wear every day. I’ve recommended this to so many people, and every time they’re impressed by how effortlessly it blends and how natural it looks. If you’ve struggled to find a zinc sunscreen that actually looks and feels good, this is the one to try.

So many reasons I will keep using this product. First of all I cannot do regular foundation anymore it just doesn't work for me. This gives my face just enough color while evening out my skin tone and it makes the pores on my nose look so much better. It's a great moisturizer and I wish I would've tried it sooner. I am on my second bottle and I will use it year-round. Believe it or not I have gotten to like the smell of it but it does dissipate once it's on your face. It takes about 10 minutes to dry down enough to start putting on the rest of your stuff... blush concealer etc. All this talk about the smell shouldn't be a game changer since it doest stick around. I've been out with it in direct sun for hours and didn't even begin to burn.

This is my second purchase of this and I actually really like it. I’m a guy so I wasn’t looking for something that looks like I have makeup on, I just wanted a moisturizer that covers some pigmentation spots, and this works great. It goes on smoothly and leaves my face looking matte—no shine! Also, there IS a smell to it, but it isn’t this horrible scent that people are describing. It’s not gonna smell like coconut or mint or anything because it’s not supposed to. And honestly, once you apply it you can’t even smell it. So I’d recommend!

This product is so amazing. It literally blends with your skin tone. I’m very light complected. I love that it also has a sun blocker and moisturizer in it. It feels so light but helps you look like you did a little something to your face. Buy it, highly recommend.
The best lightweight makeup coverage. Doesn’t cake pores. Leaves skin feeling dewy and soft. Lasts all day. Have tried 3 other brands. This one far surpasses the others. Will buy again.

Perfect coverage, feels smooth, and leaves my skin beautifully glowy! ✨ I love that it gives me a natural, dewy finish without feeling heavy. It has become a go-to in my routine, and I keep it on Subscribe & Save so I never run out. Definitely a favorite!

I am in my mid-seventies, sensitive pale skin, reacts to everything. I needed a light coverage tinted moisturizer to even out my skin tone. This does the job, well enough; but not sure I would buy again. The dewy finish goes on greasy and shiny, and it smells like ground beef about to go bad when first applied. Really nasty. Middle-aged me would find this way too oily. I will keep searching for a better product. It improves my appearance maybe 20 percent.

OMy! This must be the best SPF I have ever used ..and I am not easy to compliments. It is glowy but not overly shiny, it sinks into my 38 y.o. skin without going into the lines or accentuating my pores. It does not move, even with a rich moisturiser underneath. I have a light to medium very olivy skin and when I saw how pink it is I panicked, but somehow the colour blends well with my skin and my natural complexion still comes through nicely. It is not a foundation and it won't cover all imperfections, but it's enough for me as I prefer a natural look .. and can't really fake a perfect skin at this age ;) It protects me for the sun, but I don't burn easily and I live in England ☁️... so you might benefit from someone's else opinion on this. It's ridiculously pricey - let's be honest. But if you can afford it, I do recommend it. If you don't want to stretch to the price tag, look for a dupe, as it is really good.

My absolute favourite. Makes my face look even, smooths out pores and isn’t too greasy once dried. It offers very very light coverage, but I do not have problematic skin so for me this is perfect - it does not cover up the way foundation does. It does have a light scent, but it goes away after a few minutes. It is a bit pricy but seems to last a long time. I have recommended to friends and they also agree that it’s a really good tinted moisturizer with SPF.

This has replaced every foundation I have ever had. I can’t be without this one. It makes my skin look so nice. Like make up but no make up. It’s perfect, I love it!! On the days I want more coverage I mix it with a tiny bit of a bb cream and it’s so lovely!!
Este producto es excelente pero lo he pedido en dos ocasiones del mismo vendedor y llega roto, con la crema fuera del envase o sin funcionar. Lo he tenido que regresar.

avis.titre: Lovely cream but has a musty scent
avis.texte: This is a nice lightweight cream which leaves a lovely sheen and doesn’t pill under makeup. The tint isn’t really visible on your face. I’m deducting stars because of the horrible musty scent, as if it has gone off. Such a pity. I wonder whether I have a bad product or whether this cream always smells this way.

avis.titre: Great for Brown Skin, Just Avoid the Eye Area
avis.texte: I've been using this tinted moisturizer for about four years, and it's still my favorite daily sunscreen. As someone with brown skin, it's hard to find a sunscreen that doesn't leave a white cast, but this blends in beautifully and looks very natural. The niacinamide in it has helped improve my skin over time too. When I'm wearing makeup, I apply a layer of CeraVe Lightweight Moisturizing Lotion over it, and it layers well without pilling. The only downside for me is that if I apply it over my eyelids or too close to my eyes, it can sting for a while and make my eyes water. I've noticed this especially if I take an afternoon nap while wearing just the sunscreen without makeup.
I bought this for my 86-year-old mother. She loves how it feels and looks on her skin. It doesn't settle into her wrinkles.

avis.titre: Goes on easy & it’s very light on your skin!
avis.texte: I purchased my 2nd bottle of this tinted, SPF moisturizer. I always wear a SPF face lotion year round as it’s important to protect your face from the sun & help reduce the signs of aging. This is a nice, light moisturizer. I use a makeup sponge to apply it to my face & neck. It doesn’t take much to cover your face so it took me awhile to go thru my 1st bottle. It comes in 2 shades but it’s very light in color when applied to your face. I can’t even tell that I have it on. See photo after I rubbed the lotion in. I don’t notice it having a scent to it which I’m fine with. Definitely worth the inexpensive price.

avis.titre: Must have in my daily routine!
avis.texte: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ I absolutely love this tinted SPF facial lotion! It blends perfectly with my skin and gives just the right amount of natural-looking coverage without feeling like I'm wearing foundation. I don't typically wear foundation, so having a little tint built into my daily SPF is exactly what I was looking for. The sun protection lasts all day, it feels lightweight, and it doesn't leave my skin greasy or cakey. The best part? It's about half the price of other similar tinted SPF products I've tried, and I honestly like it even better. This has quickly become a staple in my everyday routine!

avis.titre: Feels good on skin but questionable regarding quantity.
avis.texte: I purchased this product as a gift for my daughter, and she is pleased with its performance, especially its ability to provide the right amount of moisture for her face along with sun protection, which is great. However, my only concern lies with the size of the bottle. At 1.7 oz, the bottle appears disproportionately large, creating a deceptive impression of the actual quantity of product it contains. My daughter uses only a pea-sized amount, and it feels like either the bottle we received is defective or there isn't as much product inside as expected. To illustrate this issue, I have attached a photo comparing the size of this 1.7 oz DRMTLGY Tinted Moisturizer with SPF 46. Universal Tint. All-In-One Face Sunscreen and Founda product with another that contains 1.8 oz. The IT CC+ Nude Glow Lightweight Foundation plus sunscreen I bought for myself. Even though I use the IT sunscreen and moisturizer myself on the regular (though not daily), I've been using it for nearly two months, and there's still product left. In contrast, my daughter's bottle, used only when she goes to school, is rapidly running out after just over two weeks. This raises concerns about the actual quantity of product in the bottle or potential issues with dispensing. The product however is good and at the price of $25! purchasing another! They just need to fix the dispenser and make sure the bottle is adequately full!!!

This is my gold standard tinted sun block for face, neck and hands, have never worn foundation but now consider this my perfect coverage and have been wearing for years. I always have a backup ordered so I don’t go a day without it.

I've been using this tinted moisturizer as my daily makeup for about 2 years. I love that I can apply an appropriate "sunscreen amount" and it's not too much because it's a sheer coverage (I'm fair, blue/blonde). It's never orange, never pills. It gives a fresh, slightly dewy finish. If you're combo like me, brushing powder across the t-zone will mattify it if needed, but mostly I just go with it. I've used a bunch of DRMTLGY products and all of them are solid!

avis.titre: A MUST have!! Every day use! Skin feels amazing!
avis.texte: 10/10 RECOMMEND! I’ve have been using this for several years now and won’t go back! It goes on so light, so even if you have more oily skin this would still work great! I have dryer skin and this feels amazing on it! It really does match your skin tone super well and the spf is high enough that I’ve never gotten burned wearing it EVER!! I usually use it as a bottom layer when I am going out and putting on make up, but because of the spf I use it when I don’t put on make up too! It honestly helps my face come to life each morning! LOVE LOVE LOVE!! Buy this today!!!

avis.titre: Worth your money if you don’t like cakey makeup
avis.texte: This stuff is what I’ve been looking for. It’s expensive but worth it in my opinion. If you don’t wear a lot of makeup, this is a great option. I usually only wear concealer and powders (bronzer, blush, setting). I do not like when foundation or other face products makes me look like I’m wearing foundation. This product sits amazing on the skin and does not make me look like I’m wearing anything. Today I used 3 pumps which I think was too much (seen in photo with concealer, bronzer, blush over top). I think 2 pumps is a preferred amount. Can’t wait to try the matte version this summer!

I feel kind of duped by social media for convincing me to get this product. I did get it on sale during prime days so I guess that’s ok. There is next to no coverage, so I’m not sure what product all the people in the ads are using to get so much coverage. It is lightweight, which is nice and my skin feels nice. But I far prefer the Neutrogena healthy skin anti-aging perfector over this product. And the Neutrogena product is half the cost. I’m also incredibly bothered over the deceiving packaging. In my picture, you can see my 3 ounce Tula skincare product next to the 1.7 ounce bottle of this product. It even feels super heavy when you pick up the product. Making you think that there is a lot more in here for your money than some of the other products that work better. That was one of the main reasons I decided to try this product was because of how much I thought I was getting. Granted, I should’ve looked at the ounces on the bottle and realized that they were pulling one over on us, so lesson learned. Won’t be buying this again.

I was looking for a replacement anti-aging moisturizer that had a slight tint, something I could wear on days I didn’t feel like doing a full face of makeup—just a little something to even things out. The bottle looks nice and clean, and I love that it dispenses just the right amount. The texture is super lightweight, which is a big plus, but I was hoping it would go on a little thicker for more coverage. It’s definitely a nice everyday moisturizer, just don’t expect it to cover much. Not a bad product at all—just depends on what you’re looking for!

avis.titre: Use every morning to go to work ,gym or market
avis.texte: I love it I'm using this product for almost 3 years and I love my skin I'm 61 years old this may and a lot of people tell I don't look like the age I use it only one time went I shower clean my face I put some retinol serum let my face dry after I use this product to go out and protect my skin look like make up but not make up 😍😍😍😍😍

I love the glow this gives my skin. The tint helps me feel like I don’t need to wear make up. It does have a sort of weird smell to it but not bad enough to not wear. You really can’t beat the price for all of the benefits. Will likely purchase again when I finish my bottle.

I’ll be honest I think this is the first Amazon review I’ve ever left and I get packages several times a week. All of my hobbies are outdoors, including hiking and bass fishing year-round. I bought my first bottle of tinted moisturizer a little over a year ago and I ran out two days ago Ordered a new bottle came in last night. This is a very light wearing tinted moisturizer works as a buffer for your skin and as a sunblock prior to me using this, I would get sunburn on my face frequently because of my outdoor hobbies -there have been several times this summer Where my body burned except for my face because I had this on. This is not to be confused with a full coverage foundation, but if you’re looking for something to give you a subtle boost while providing SPF coverage you will not be disappointed by this. my other go to is supergoop as far as SPF coverage, they are the same for me however, super goop gives you more of a highlight/bronze look, but is four times the price

The product itself is good. It has a light to medium texture, spreads easily, and absorbs well without leaving any stains. However, the smell is very unpleasant—it reminds me of old lipstick. I’m not sure whether this is its normal scent or if I may have received an older product, even though it was sealed and had a valid expiration date.

avis.titre: Matte tinted sunscreen.... I was blown away!!
avis.texte: This is the best all in one skincare product I've ever used. So I got the matte version. I'm 45 yrs old. Oily in my T zone. At first it appeared to be dewy and a little yellowish on my face when I first applied it. But after it dried down for just a few minutes...and I lightly sprinkled a tiny bit of translucent powder across my T zone it looked fabulous! I was pleasantly surprised. It doesn't cover dark spots but it does make me look like I have a very thin layer of sheer coverage foundation on. I do prefer to use a moisturizer before but that's my personal preference. Someone with younger skin may not need to. In my photo I'm only wearing the matte tinted sunscreen and a bit of blush.

I love this stuff! I don’t wear makeup and I’m very picky about what I put on my face. I don’t like anything heavy, sticky or cakey, and this stuff is not any of those things. It’s lightweight, feels good, and I like knowing that the SPF is protecting my skin. It also matches my skin tone perfectly and blends really well. This is my second bottle and I will continue to buy more when I run out. My only complaint is that it’s expensive; I do wish it was a little bit cheaper.

I have purchased this product many times.It feels good and is easy to use.I noticed I had to reorder more frequently and after having the product for just a week it was empty.I unscrewd the top and to my dismay found that the bottle has a small cup at the mouth of the can that holds the 1.8oz .I inserted a Qtip inside the cup and it stopped short and was dry.The package is deceiving and I feel too much money for such a small amount. Disappointed .
This is a five star plus product. I love the coverage, and the seat look. As a licensed aesthetician, from the step forward, I will be recommending this to all of my clients whose faces I love.

Wanted a moisturizing foundation that was light/sheer, so my freckles would pop through. Feels like I have nothing on! I will say it is very sheer, so if you're looking for complexion coverage... this might not be the best.
This is the BEST tinted sunscreen. I never even wear foundation anymore because this product works so well. Especially the new Matte Finish. Looks really natural.

avis.titre: Not worth the price and  tint effect is not there!
avis.texte: I like the the lightweight texture of this moisturizer and it doesn’t leave the skin looking “caked”. It goes on smoothly and has a very slight sheen or dewy appearance. The packaging in my opinion for the cost is cheap and doesn’t have a luxury weight in the bottle. I don’t think the tint is high enough and doesn’t cover and imperfections at all. I don’t believe the SPF sunscreen would work based on my experience with other skincare with SPF. When it dries on the skin you see no difference between areas with the lotion and without. Not worth the price!

avis.titre: Great for weekend/ low key day
avis.texte: Love for a weekend makeup replacement to have something on my skin. Tinting is very light but is a good moisturizer.

avis.titre: Product is smooth and nice. Bottle disappointing
avis.texte: First things first- the sunscreen is very nice. It goes on so smooth. Blends in well and doesn’t feel like you even have sunscreen on. No real scent either. My disappointment is in the bottle I got Within the first few days of using the sunscreen I had sunscreen coming out the side of the lid and getting all over. I also found it didn’t pump very well. Then one morning I press the pump and the bottom explodes off. To reveal thankfully, a bottle within a bottle, so I didn’t get sunscreen all over. But I’m not sure if I had a faulty bottle since it always leaked and then finally broke.

I bought dewy directly from drmtlgy and matte from amazon. They’re very similar. I saw some reviews complaining of a smell, but they smell exactly the same and it’s a very normal, mild scent. I personally prefer the dewy version and only took off one star because my face tanned a bit through the matte sunscreen. The tint is very sheer and it feels really light and non greasy on skin.

If you’re stuck between EltaMD and Drmtlgy then heres a little side by side. I decided to not keep either one, only because they’re both extremely sheer and not what I’m looking for. Drmt has a white cast that turns pink. If you’re white and/or pink then I guess it’ll work? The texture is a lot lighter and “watery” compared to EltaMD. If I were to pick one, id be Elta only because I’m tanned and feel it looks better on tan skin. Pictures with and without flash. Hope this helps! thanks for reading. Bye :)

Sorry for the creepy photo - trying to maintain some anonymity. But this stuff is fantastic. Perfect shade (for me), lightweight, light coverage but not translucent, and didn’t dry out my skin. The After (right) photo is after I’ve worn it all day. I’ve tried other tinted moisturizers with SPF that left me dry, flaky, and even burned my under eyes. But this stuff left my skin hydrated, dewy, and definitely no burning. I will say - I use argan oil everyday under my lotion, so that might help. I used 1.5 pumps for my whole face. Not sure how long the bottle will last. But this is definitely a good product. Let’s hope they don’t discontinue it!

avis.titre: Great for oily skin, brown girl friendly!
avis.texte: I love this tinted sunscreen! I wish I had tried it sooner. While I usually prefer mineral sunscreens, I occasionally make an exception and this is one of them. I know a lot of other people love this but I was skeptical about the color match. Brown girls don’t always get this lucky. Turns out, it blends in beautifully into my skin. This does not have any cast on me at all. The coverage is very sheer and barely there, very natural; so it’s not covering up any imperfections. The texture is like a lightweight moisturizer, not runny, and it spreads very easily. Reapplication is a breeze. This is not a sweat resistant formula so it’s not for beach days. However, it’s a great option for daily wear. I have oily skin and this has a natural finish. It’s such an elegant formula. No irritation, no breakouts, and it doesn’t burn my eyes. It feels moisturizing but not heavy. The bottle arrived with a tamper proof seal. And the pump works great, no issues. I think the price is fine for such a nice formula and packaging. But if you can get it on sale, don’t hesitate! I also love these tinted sunscreens: Neutrogena Mineral UV Tint in Medium Deep, Elta MD UV Daily Tinted, Colorscience Flex in Tan (has more coverage to even out skin tone). Some of my foundation colors in case it helps you determine if this tint works for you: Armani 7.8, ELDW Honey Bronze, KVD 063, MUFE 3N42, Haus Labs 330, Dior 4N, Nars Aruba.

After the Purito scandal, I was desperate for a new daily sunscreen and this was my first option because it was recommended by Dr. Dray. This is very moisturizing without being greasy, and it just looks better with each reapplication. The tint is also perfect for hiding redness on my cheeks and nose. Most importantly, it doesn’t break me out! For reference, I have sensitive, dry, acne prone skin. Edit: I recently purchased this product from the official website and noticed that the tint is slightly lighter than the one I got from Amazon. I’m not sure if I received an old bottle, or if it oxidizes over time, or if it just needs to be shaken, but I’m no longer comfortable buying from here. As you can see from the pictures I uploaded, the bottles are also slightly different. The bottle caps and bottom parts have very slightly different sizes. On the plus side, there was no difference at all in texture. There was less of a scent on the one from the official website, but the textures were just the same so I’m guessing it was probably an old bottle which was upgraded?
Just purchased my second bottle today! I have oily skin and wfh sitting next to a window during the day, this is light weight for that barely there makeup look with the spf of 46. Great product!

This product comes in a nice pump bottle. It has a nice light creamy consistency. This is three pumps in my hand. It goes on light and pretty luminous. Dries down pretty well after a while. Only one tinted color to choose from and not universal as advertised. Too light for my skin tone, could not wear this as a standalone product. Has a smell like clay… But wears pretty well. Would love to see some different tinted color levels. Do not get it in your eyes, it stings quite a bit. Had to flush my eyes after I accidentally got some in the corners. I would not say that it is oily, but it does take some time for it to dry down. It stayed tacky on my skin for quite a while.

I purchased this because I love being in the sun but I dislike getting burnt, freckles, and wrinkles. This helps protect me from the sun and the long term effects of the with the SPF of 46. This tinted moisturizer is good for any skin complexion. Can use in place of liquid foundation. Has a glow and shimmer to it which makes your skin look fresh. This is non-greasy and non-tacky. Goes on so smooth. I highly recommend this!

Did a side by side comparison with this product and another product (as seen in the picture). This one lost as far as tint and smell goes. It did moisturize nicely though. I will keep it as a moisturizer, but when I want some tint/light coverage, I will be using the other product in the picture. I guess you get what you pay for - at least with this. I was hoping this would be at least as good as the other one. I have not worn either product before tonight. Also, this is my impression immediately after putting them on plus the next 10 minutes afterwards to give them time to settle. So I cannot give an opinion at this time regarding longevity.

I am 62 and from 18 until today - I don't wear makeup or foundation. Because every one I have tried even tints burns my skin and feel like torture on my face or near my eyes. I only wear nontoxic lipstick. Bit I saw this online and found it on Amazon and decided to try it. OMG...I found a blessing. I live in the Caribbean in the winters and could find a sunscreen for my face that didn't burn either ...hence the caps to block the sun. NOW I have 2 products in one. IT seems to match any skin color or type. Not caulk like and give a glow. I added my Moringa oil as a base just in case. An added bonus it does not stain anything white. It just blends into you skin and Dissapears. GO 4 IT!!!

avis.titre: My sister hooked me up with this
avis.texte: Wow it’s like not wearing anything and I’m liking it a lot my sister had cancer and reads all the reviews and 22,000 + says a lot too… she loves use sing hers , so my sister let me try it and I loved it it stayed on all day compared to my makeup any way.. it feels light and I still have a look of makeup to me but it’s not caked on or looking like I just sweat it off .. I’m happy just got it and I’m really happy that I spent the money I really didn’t need to spend but I feel better about me when in public.. that’s for me to feel better about me…I don’t wear a lot of makeup except maybe my eyes.. but still learning on my face now that I’m 58… this picture is just running around but it looks like I have base on and I’m happy 😊

I would rate this as 5 star as I love the product. But today I went to use it in the morning as I normally do and as I pulled the lid off the bottom broke out and the product insert fell to the floor. Well I was upset but ok as I could just still use it but the pump straw and the top of the pump broke as well.. very disappointed with it!!!

I was really excited about purchasing this product. I've been using SPF tinted moisturizers for years and thought I would give DRMTLGY a try. From the reviews it sounded great! It does go on beautifully. It gives a nice dewy finish. However, there is virtually no color distinction whatsoever before and after. In my photo, the hand on the top is the one where I applied the tinted moisturizer. I'm now combining it with my previous tinted moisturizer to get the color I wanted. I'll continue to do this until I use up the DRMTLGY product. I won't be buying it in the future.

avis.titre: Everything I need in one product!
avis.texte: I love makeup, but now that I’m 51, I’m embracing a lighter and more natural routine for everyday wear. I’ve been using this Anti-Aging Tinted Moisturizer, and I absolutely love it! It’s everything I need in one product, light coverage that evens out my skin tone, SPF for daily sun protection, and a formula that leaves my face feeling fresh and hydrated. It doesn’t feel heavy, and it gives me a healthy, radiant glow. Perfect for mature skin and anyone looking to simplify their makeup routine without sacrificing results! Love it!! 💫

avis.titre: I shouldn’t have waited so long to purchase
avis.texte: You live under a rock if you haven’t seen this advertised for the last hand full of years. I don’t know why I never purchased it. Why did I wait so long, perhaps I thought it was just marketing. I purchased 5 tinted sunscreens at once because I was on the hunt for a good one. This was it. This one is so light and dewy, perfect for dry or mature skin. It wears well under makeup. It wears well as makeup. Highly recommend. And the price is reasonable for the quality.

avis.titre: I have dry to normal skin and I love it
avis.texte: I love it! I have dry skin and I just won’t give 5 starts because It does feel a little oily on my skin when I first apply it but after couple minutes the oily feeling is gone! It hidrates my skin and it has no strong smell what I really appreciate. Even thought it is a tinted sun screen there is no real color change in my skin and I really like it because there is no “white residues” all over my face and I believe that this should Also work amazing for darker skin. it is also easy to apply and It works well under make up. I will definitely be buying this again and so far this is my New Favorite Sun Screen. I am recommending this to all my friends and family with normal to dry Skin.. I took a picture with a deodorant by its sides so you can see that the product is also generous in amount.

I received this free for testing purposes but my review includes all my own thoughts. I love a tinted sunscreen especially because I’m someone who likes a more minimal makeup look for everyday. I love that this tinted moisturizer is moisturizing enough on its own so that I don’t need to apply a separate moisturizer unless my skin is feeling extra dry. I have combination and sensitive skin and this does not break me out or irritate my skin at all. It also blends out so smoothly on the skin and wears well under makeup and other skincare products. It does have a slight scent of crayons or traditional bullet lipsticks, but it’s not a lingering scent and I don’t smell it once it’s blended out. It’s a great one and done product and I really love wearing it. In my photo, the only base makeup I'm wearing is this tinted moisturizer. I also took this photo on a canon camera in front of a window, so you can see the product on my skin in natural light.

avis.titre: No coverage, will try a different product
avis.texte: I see ZERO difference as far as coverage goes. Looks like I am not wearing anything. Was really hoping for a simply, spf product to help cover some redness and dark spots in a quick few minute application. But nope, will try a different brand. Does go on smooth and I don’t feel it all, if you’re looking for a lightweight moisturizer and spf, this is it, but no coverage. Photo is after I applied 2 rounds of it. I see no difference. Disappointed but now I know.

avis.titre: Please make sure you wrap this product
avis.texte: I love this item and I would love to continue to order from Amozon, but just please make sure you wrap it and some bubble wrap or somethingThis is the second one I got busted.

I have sensitive skin and don’t like to wear a lot of makeup. I’ve been looking for a new sunscreen that could provide a light tint, and I was really excited to try this. At first glance I liked it. The formula is sheer with a nice radiant finish. Unfortunately the tint was too bronze-y for my fair skin and made me look muddy. As the day went on my face became very shiny and looked oily, even though my skin is on the dry side. Overall this didn’t work for me. It might work better for someone with at least light-medium or darker skin tones and for someone who wants an extremely dewy look. In the photos I’m wearing this product on the right and my usual tinted sunscreen on the left.

Bought this to give it a try. Falls short of the hype. Not as tinted as its expensive cousins. It even seems shimmery but after putting it on, there isn’t much glow to it. I have used Rare’s Tinted Moisturizer and it works much better at tinting.

I’ve tried different moisturizers with spf.. This one is a TGC (total game changer). For the first time in years, my dry skin has a glow. I usually have super dry skin at 65 yoa , premenopausal. I’ve tried everything but it stops here. It doesn’t have much color to it so I dab CC by IT on the makeup brush and apply it to my face. ** I’ll never search or switch products as I’m very satisfied……finally. Using a makeup brush really helps apply the product evenly. xx

I bought the original dewy formula and I absolutely LOVE it! I have been searching for the right product for my mature (59yr old) skin and THIS is the jackpot!! I was worried about the color matching because I just returned a high-end brand’s tinted moisturizer because it was Oompa Loompa orange, this is not orange at all. You get a nice, big bottle of it for a reasonable price. I am wearing it with the Drmtlgy Luminous Eye Corrector in fair, which I also LOVE! Great products… home run!!

I usually really like products from this brand so I had high hopes for this tinted moisturizer. But calling it tinted is way too generous. There is zero coverage. You can see in the photos I have attached there’s hardly a difference between the two. The first is prior to applying the product and the second is after. Even though the product looks tinted, it barely shows up on the skin. It is lightweight and feels nice on the skin. I do feel like it moisturizes but I can’t speak much to how well the SPF protection works at this point. The ingredients don’t list anything abnormal but I did wake up with swollen eyes after using it so I’m not sure if I had some form of allergic reaction to it or not. There’s no odor and doesn’t leave a greasy residue on the skin so those are some positives of the product. I was just overall disappointed and expected to like this more considering how much I like this brand.

avis.titre: Not at all what I expected.
avis.texte: Has a very musty odor. Not what I expected. I have a fair complexion and hoped this would at least even out my skin tone so I could go without liquid makeup but I really don’t notice any difference in my redness or uneven skin tone.

I don’t like makeup, other than lipstick, but I like to have a lil shimmer on my face. This stuff is Fantastic!! I’ve used it for about a year now as a moisturizer over my vitamin C cream. It’s not heavy at all and leaves my skin radiant. I have normal to dry skin, it isn’t greasy or heavy. It doesn’t feel like there is anything on my face, but I can definitely tell a difference when I don’t use it. At 45 I get more compliments on my skin than I did in my 20’s and 30’s and I actually work makeup back then! 😆

Shame on me for not reading the label, I thought this was a zinc sunscreen but it also includes octinoxate which so many other sunscreens (even the bad ones) have banned. It’s a shame because I really like the product!

I have been using the product on the left for many years and have loved it but it is becoming more difficult to find so I tried this product on the right and so far so good! It is a little thicker than what I've been using but it feels great on the skin especially on my face. I wish it was closer in color to the one on the left though. If they added a little more pigment, it would make it a close to perfect product. I would definately purchase again though. The quantity is about double the amount that I was getting with the other product so that is good but I do have to use a little more because it is less pigmented. Consumers are looking for a product that will make them look flawless and this would do it if it had more pigment to it. I am a Caucasian that spends time in the sun and this is a good product to recommend.

avis.titre: Another over hyped product & bad packaging
avis.texte: I wasn't expecting a lot of coverage but there is absolutely no tint to this product. It's a little oily/shiny when applying but it does dry down a little bit. But within a couple of hours, my t-zone was a shiny oily mess. It may be fine for someone with flawless skin or that's dry/normal. But if you're looking for something to even out your skin a little and/or you have oily/combo skin skip it, it's just another over-hyped product. UPDATE: Originally rated 3 stars but now bumping it down to 2 star after taking it on a trip. When I arrived the package was broken and a total mess. It was not in a checked bag where it was being thrown around, I carried it on the plane. It can still be used with just the inner tube/container and without the lid but now it's not portable. The one good thing I can say is that I used it as my main face sunscreen for 6 days in the Caribbean and it did provide good protection and I did not get burned. Also, there is no white cast you can get with some sunscreens. But with everything else bad about it I will not repurchase it.

This is a great sunscreen if you are NOT looking for coverage. As you can see in the photo, you can see my acne still. It definitely gave me a nice glow and made my pores appear smaller. I will be wearing this to the lake and beach but will still need a fuller coverage foundation for date nights.

avis.titre: Tinted sunscreen is not for me
avis.texte: I am really picky with my tinted sunscreen. I need it to blend. Unfortunately, this sunscreen left me with a bit of white cast. While it may not be noticeable for others, to me, it just doesn’t work. I don’t know why companies won’t make tints in multiple shade ranges. I get that the universal tint is supposed to help with the range, but it doesn’t. I’m tired of taking five - seven minutes trying to blend. It does blend smoothly with my other products but that’s the only positive.

avis.titre: Lightweight and Moisturizing but Very Little Tint
avis.texte: I've been using this product for about a week and find it to fit most of what I am looking for. I've been spending a lot of time outside and am looking to shorten my skincare and makeup routine. This product is extremely lightweight and hydrating. However, if you want something to also work as a lightweight foundation this is not the product. It goes on almost sheer as if you are not wearing anything tinted. Personally, I prefer a tinted moisturizer with a slight more tint to help even out my skin tone. Skin Type: dry, sensitive, acne-prone Skin Tone: fair Pros: -Very lightweight -Good sun protection -More moisturizing than other tinted moisturizers I've tried -Does not sweat off Con: -It goes on very sheer, almost as if it's not tinted at all.

This is moisturizing and has a very light coverage. It goes on with a dewy finish, but dries pretty much matte. Nice for Summer months when you want a cleaner makeup look. I am showing what one pump looks like on my hand here. It only took two pumps to do my whole face. The bottle should last a while, depending on how much you use it, obviously.

I don’t wear makeup, but I do wear sunscreen. I love this product it’s not shinny like most sunscreens. It gives a beautiful even tone on my skin. I feel like I’m not wearing anything. I love skincare and this tinted moisturizer with sunscreen is worth every penny. I have tried other products and with my darker skin tone. Other products have left my face very light and don’t match my skin tone. But this product blends in perfectly! I’m so happy I found it. This is my second bottle. The first bottle lasted about 6months.

avis.titre: Love the product hate the packaging
avis.texte: Love this product. I have very sensitive skin and this does not break me out at all. However the packaging is terrible and how it is shipped. Received with makeup leaking around plastic seal and decided to clean it up and use it anyway. Second day of use I pushed down on the pump and the entire bottom broke off from the actual bottle that is inside. I’m guessing it must of been cracked in shipping and I never noticed until now. You know a product is good when I still am not going to return is because that’s how much I love the product on my skin and it’s still usable just it’s now in its less attractive packaging.

The holy grail of face sunscreens. Up until now I haven't been great about applying sunscreen to my face because either it stings, leaves a white cast, feels heavy, or all of the above. This stuff is like heaven. It's light, with an almost watery feel when I spread it across my face, making it easy to get all of my face covered vs fighting against it getting tacky. Once it sets after a few minutes, it just feels like you put on moisturiser. The tint looked like more than I expected when I first pumped it out, but once it's spread across the face it's super sheer. It's definitely not a substitute if you like the look of foundation and heavier makeup, but it's perfect if you're more the type to dab on some concealer and mascara and go. Also it does have a certain glow to it - not a greasy glow but like a "lit from within" glow. I think I'll actually look forward to wearing sunscreen now!

This is seriously an all in 1 product. It adds a little bit of coverage, hydrates the skin, protects it from the sun, and has anti-aging benefits! My honest review: This is great for those who are comfortable with a VERY light coverage foundation. I wish it had just a little bit more coverage, but it blends seamlessly in the skin which is nice. It does have a bit of a sticky feeling on the skin, but nothing out of the ordinary. It didn’t irritate my sensitive skin which is a great sign. It did add quite a bit of moisture and a whole lot of a healthy GLOW! That is my favorite part about this product! The anti aging ingredients are such an amazing addition!

I like the product. I do notice that when I wipe it off at the end of the day that is looks darker than when I applied it. But, that being said, it looks fine on my face and I like that it has SPF in it.

Very disapointed in the packaging and performance of the container. The Amazon folks had it tightly packaged and did it right. However, because of how this product leaked out, my suspicions are the container was already cracked and broken from the factory. The bottle is hard plastic and very unforgiving. The outer container wasn’t cracked. It was the inside threads holding the top and bottom together. I GENTLY opened this product to use the day I got it. The plastic thread rings apparently were already broken and fell out. The product was all over the outside of the bottle. The pump would not pull the liquid through at first and after several efforts I finally got it to work by pushing the bottom of the pump. The odor several reviews mentioned is there momentarily then goes away. For a tinted suncreen it is okay, however, I didn’t see the big deal and it was average at best. This will be the one time and only time I order it. Drmatology, with all you advertisement hype and the money you are spending, you could have done a much better job on your container. It wasted alot of product. So much for my $29.00

I like the product. It gives a light coverage, which is what I wanted. The ad that got me to purchase claimed that this is a primer, moisturizer, and sunscreen, while also providing light coverage. IF you have deep pores, you'll want to use an additional primer for sure. Packaging is the downfall. When I took the plastic wrap off and removed the cap, there was product all over. The pump wasn't screwed on tightly so product escaped. I tightened the pump, but it loosened after a few uses and more product spilled out. In addition, there was a large crack almost all the way around the bottmo circumference of the tube. I asked for a replacement so we'll see how that turns out. In my opinion, this product is too expensive to have such defective packaging.

I've been buying this face tint over the years and always loved it, but sadly, the last package had a terrible, rancid smell that I couldn't put on my face after two tries, and while I'd love to give it a second chance, I'm honestly too afraid to buy it again moving forward;(⭐️

This product is so sheer and lightweight. I've not been able to use any type of sunscreen in the past because I always broke out. I think that I finally found something that works for me! A lot of reviews state that there is no tint. I beg to differ. I reapplied today due to more sun exposure than usual (school event) & there was product/tint when I went to wash my hands. This product gives a light tint, it's not to be confused with medium to heavy coverage foundation.

My day can’t start without it! After my morning skincare routine, this is a must do next step! Then I apply my makeup. I love that it has spf and keeps make moisturized while added some light coverage.

The coverage is not great. But I use it for the SPF and how it makes my skin look & feel. I use it as a base, or primer, before I use my "foundation" (it's more like a lightweight skin tint). This stuff goes on so smooth AND gives me that glow of healthy, moisturized skin that I absolutely love. I ran out of this product (there's not much warning, it just dies) & it took a while for my new order to come so there was several days I did my regular morning skin routine but obviously had to skip using this, and I could totally feel the difference. My skin felt drier which means wrinkles will always be way more prominent. This lotion is completely awesome!! I highly recommend it.

I can’t rave about this product enough! I’ve used it for over two years now and love it. It is lightweight, doesn’t have the typical sunscreen texture, offers a fair amount of coverage and the color I get is spot on. There have been days I just use this product, a setting powder and a little blush and I’m out the door. It leaves my skin feeling soft and my skin can actually breathe while I’m wearing it.

I have very pale and dry skin, the tint is certifiably completely sheer and very dry skin friendly. Which is amazing after fighting white cast in the previous, I'd say five - ten different daily spf products. I'm probably sticking to this one long term. It sinks in leaving nothing but dewy ultra-smooth skin. I've attached three pictures. One of how it pumps out (doesn't run all over the place) another of a single circular motion showing its consistency when it sits on the skin, and the final one of my still very fair skin and the subtle glow left behind after rubbing it in from my wrist line to about half an inch before the pic cuts off I've already reccomended this to multiple friends. Will likely update when I finish this bottle.

What I love about this product is, it's so light. non greasy feel to it. it has UVA UVB protection especially since I'm always out during the summer time. of course you can wear it in the winter as well. it also lasted a while for me.

My favorite tinted moisturizer! And the fact that has SPF makes it the best! I absolutely love the matte version that came out. I used the original before. The matte is not as greasy feeling as the original. It goes on so easy! I typically use it solo as daily wear but will layer it with a loose powder for more completed makeup look. Love this product!!

Love how this goes on. Makes my skin a slightly darker tint without needing a foundation. I’m fortunate to have clear skin but I do have some redness on my cheeks that I like to cover, but I could get away with putting on some concealer. The product did come in damaged. I didn’t return it because it’s still usable. Just clearly wasn’t handled too carefully during shipping and handling.

avis.titre: Yes! Best tinted moisturizer with best glow!
avis.texte: This tinted moisturizer is a fantastic addition to my daily routine. The application is incredibly smooth and effortless. It provides a natural, healthy glow without any excess shine. My skin feels comfortable and not at all oily throughout the day. I highly recommend this product for a lightweight, radiant look.

avis.titre: Matte Universal Tint—NOT for cool tone skin
avis.texte: I had high hopes for this, and was unfortunately disappointed. I am very pale, so tints can be a gamble… but I can usually make it work (some give me the look of a slight tan, which is nice!) However, this was so yellow that I could not use it without a neutralizer. *Maybe* people with a little more tan or brown can make this work, but if you are a cooler tone skin, I would definitely pause before buying this. As far as the product goes with feel, I absolutely loved it. Which is why I was so disappointed that the color was so off!

avis.titre: Great moisturizer, doesn’t leave me greasy, needs more tint
avis.texte: I bought this moisturizer and I tried it for a week, normally my face is semi dry but it’s gets really bad around my mouth area/smile lines that’s where I’m most dry at, and this product actually helps me normally other moisturizers leaves my skin feeling really greasy and sticky, but this one doesn’t which is awesome because my skin can’t take much more lol My only con is it’s only slightly tinted when I put it on it just gives me a glow which is good but I would like a little bit more tint. 9/10

I ordered this in July, before my order one ran out. When I opened this one, the bottom of the container was broken, the inside loosened so some of the product leaked into the lid and down the inside container. I realize I am past the return window, but since I didn't open it until today (10/24/23), I still wanted to register a complaint. I love the product, and that is why I ordered another one before my first one ran out.

After sooo many ads on instagram I had this a try. It’s ok as far as feel but mostly disappointing in the complete lack of coverage. It has color coming out of the pump but completely disappeared when I applied it. Not going to work on my red skin. It might be enough for younger flawless skin. I’ll probably keep it to go under other makeup. Sorry about the ugly picture but I thought I should share.

avis.titre: Arrived leaking but Replacement was Good
avis.texte: UPDATE: I got a replacement bottle which was sealed and I'm happy with it. The original order came leaking and unsealed. Arrived with the moisturizer leaking out the sides and top. There is none coming out when I pumped it. I unscrewed the top and there is barely any in the bottle. I’ve requested a replacement and am returning this one. I’m hoping the replacement doesn’t come with the same issue
Not great coverage I know it’s just a tinted moisturizer. Don’t really like the smell and the ingredients aren’t as clean as I would like. The texture is good.

This moisturizer works well and provides a nice tint. It is not waterproof, which is a bummer living in Florida. I compared it to the similar product from EltaMD and this one is slightly more sheer and leaves a little more tackiness to the skin, but evenually soaks in nicely. The tint on this is lighter than the EltaMD, but both work on fair skin. The top product is Drmtlgy and the bottom is EltaMD

avis.titre: This is the way I received it.
avis.texte: I really like the product I've ordered before it's like my 4th bottle. I was home on vacation for about 3 weeks when it came, so I didn't know it was broke like this till a few days after I returned and opened it. Would like to know if you will replace it. Thank you, Very satisfied with the product

avis.titre: Matte and SPG in one good buy!
avis.texte: This matte tint works very well. Goes on smooth and even The SPF is why I purchased.
Even though my bottle failed apart after one week of using it , the product itself is very good , I’d say my favorite tinted moisturizer .

avis.titre: Moisturizes BUT No Tint Coverage - Do not replace your foundation
avis.texte: I am always looking for new skincare products that give my skin an extra glow and assist in my make up routine. This is why I was so excited to try the viral TikTok DRMTLGY Tinted Moisturizer with SPF 46 - A moisturizer, sunscreen, and make-up product all in one. Overall, I gave this 3 stars for the following reasons: 1. Virtually no tint coverage: while this product does offer some great skin care benefits, the universal tint does not translate well, nor does it provide any true coverage if you are wanting to use this product as a replacement for your liquid foundation. When applied, there is no true difference in using the tinted moisturizer - no blurring of pours, no lightly tinted coverage, etc. I occasionally have acne, some light skin spots, etc, and I was hoping the tinted moisturizer would help light cover these imperfections on my face. I feel this should not have been marketed as a potential make up product, but rather just a moisturizer and sunscreen since the tint really doesn’t give any coverage, nor does it truly blur pores. 2. Light moisturizer: I do agree that this product moisturizes well and gives my face an additional sheen or glow after applying it. I also like that I can use this product in place of a make up primer as it does prep the face before applying other layers of make-up. I would even recommend using it more as a primer to sit under foundation. 3. Generous portion: The product does come in a pretty large bottle, so for the $20 I spent on it, I wo

avis.titre: Covers flaws, acts like your own skin, and SPF is great for sensitive eyes!
avis.texte: I so love this product! Don't let the packaging fool you, it works just as well at IT Cosmetics, if not better because the formula is more sheer than full coverage. The tint could work very well under makeup even. It reminds me of my Dior Baskstage primer. Which I LOVE! I've had this on the entire day, and it has not moved into fine lines or creased. It's beautiful for a natural look, and I really like feeling protected from the rays at all times. Especially, under my eyes. I usually can't wear tinted moisturizers with SPF anywhere near my eyes. They get teary immediately, but it did not happen with this product. It's worth every penny for the quality. I am repurchasing!

Universal tints are never universal. This sunscreen was too dark on my light skin. And even though my skin is dry, this sunscreen never absorbed into my skin and sat on it, staying shiny for hours. Photo has the sunscreen applied on my left hand

I do wear make up but never to much, just enough to enhance my look. I am fair skinned in the tan category so when I saw this and read the reviews I decided to purchase. Needless to say I haven’t worn makeup since I tried this. It is my everyday wear now and this natural glow has caught a lot of attention here and there so I must look pretty good…lol Hubby loves it.. When taking it off at night there is no color film on my cotton/cleanser so that tells me something. Great stuff!!

3 stars since I haven’t been able to use the product as regularly as planned and required.Cap fell off when I first opened it since it looked already loose. It is hard to not make a mess or waste product trying to use it like that. I wrote immediately to the seller / company no answer after more than a week. I wanted to try a different product since I’ve been using Tizo 3 for 15 years. Tizo 3 is matte, light, like silk and is tinted, no issues with dispensing EVER since it is a tube. I have not used any base or powder since using Tizo it helped me take care of my skin avoiding makeup. This product I will never know how good it works, can’t get it out, pump does not work.

This stuff is AWESOME. The tint really does seem universal. It blends into nothing, while still evening out my skin tone. Perfect for no-makeup days. I do find that it breaks up my makeup on my chin only when I wear this, so I wear this on no-makeup days. It’s lightweight, has a satin finish, and gives a healthy glow to the face. Has Niacinimide which is a great ingredient, and no fragrance! This is in my top 3 SPFs. I’ve gone through at least 6 bottles of this. Also, my fiancé enjoys it as well. It’s hubby approved!!! That should tell you all you need to know.

I'm 49 years old with dry skin. I wanted something that was light and moisturizing but would still look polished. This was a definite win. I look like I have makeup on without looking made up. It's very natural while still evening out my skin and feels great. Lasts all day.

avis.titre: Not allergy to my eyes and bright the skin but can't pump out the product in a month
avis.texte: My doctor friend recommended this product and it is light, easy to apply and leaves the skin glow as if you just did a ficial. Most importantly, it will not cause allergy reaction to my eyes. Unfortunately after only one month, the pump did not work anymore. I opened the top part of the bottle, find the tube that should be connecting to the top end was missing or not long enough to reach the moisturizer. What a waste if I can't use it anymore.

I love this product! I've been looking for a moisturizer/sunscreen and finally found one! It literally matches your skin tone and feels very light in your face! I did not have ny problems with no rashes or any allergic reactions! I recommend this product!
Why did you pick this product vs others?: This product is amazing! I use it everyday. It is a tinted moisturizer, but I use as a foundation. With maturing skin it is perfect!

This product is lightweight but moisturizes my dry skin. I don’t like to wear foundation but this is the perfect amount of coverage while not being heavy. I wish the company would reduce the packaging though. These 2 products are both 1.7 ounces and the Drmtlgy product is twice as big (I know…marketing).

avis.titre: Good SPF tinted moisturizer, very light / bloqueador solar y crema hydratante con color
avis.texte: It feels very light and moisturizing, the tint blends nicely on my skin no cast. It does have a characteristic scent but it fades away very quickly. It is a hybrid formula with chemical and physical sunblock actives. My skin tone is natural beige on maybelline fit me foundation, just for your reference. Se siente muy ligero e hydratante, el color se dispersa muy bien en mi piel sin dejar residuo. Tiene un olor caracteristico al aplicarlo, pero se va rapido. Es un bloqueador mixto porque tiene ambos tipos de bloqueador fisico y quimico. My tono de piel es moreno claro "natural beige" en la marca maybelline fit me.
The coverage is just enough ! There is no stickiness or tacky feeling . Lightweight… easy to use application other pump . UV protection!!! Great value for mature skin !

Very light, not a makeup substitute as it has no coverage but the sun protection is nice. I put my regular face lotion on and then put this on top. The bottle is huge for the quantity. 1.6 oz compared to much smaller and lighter bottle of bio oil that has 2.0 oz. Waste of packaging!

avis.titre: It is very sheer; needs better packaging
avis.texte: The tint is barely noticeable at all. I was looking for something light to use instead of foundation. This isn’t it. While it’s a great sunscreen that goes on well, the tint did absolutely nothing for my face. It just disappeared and looks like nothing. Edit: After putting a translucent powder on top, I like this a lot more. Increasing it to 4 stars. Edit 2: I have now had two of these completely explode on the first or second use. The packaging is horrible. Amazon needs to cushion it and/or the manufacturer needs a different design.

The level of coverage is super low. It’s a sheer tint with a matte finish. As you apply it on your face you’ll feel some texture as if it was scrubbing your skin. 😥 I had a burning feeling for the first couple of minutes. I also noticed my skin getting too dry. I think it is a low quality sunscreen. Its benefits sounds great but it doesn’t work properly. Sadly, I’ll return it.

avis.titre: Love the product but came to me leaking
avis.texte: Not happy that my item came leaking from the inside of cap. Would be nice to have a new one sent to me without the hassle of having to return the damaged one.

avis.titre: Love this product! Lightweight, high SPF and great coverage!
avis.texte: Love this product! I was skeptical at first as I had never used this brand before, but the high SPF and light tint provide perfect coverage! It feels lightweight and moisturizing! Great value for the $!!

avis.titre: Terrible bottle and pump (if you could even call it a pump)
avis.texte: Okay so I actually like the product enough to give two stars. I have to take away three stars because the packing or bottle is just horrific. It cracked just from laying it in my caboodle. But even before that the product doesn’t pump out even with vigorous efforts. For the price of this product, we deserve so much better.

Like the way it looks and the spf protection is what I need. I have ordered this successfully in the past at least three times but in the last month, I have received the one with No TINT on two different occasions the first one I thought was my mistake. The second time I double checked the order and it does say tinted version as you can see by the photo below that is not what I got someone needs to check their stock.

I like this tinted moisturizer especially on days that I don’t wear a lot of makeup (which is most days) it is a very light tint. If you’re looking for coverage, I would not get this. It is very creamy and light when it goes on. It doesn’t feel greasy. The only reason I’m giving it 4 stars is because the smell is awful. It’s not a chemical or floral smell. I can’t really describe it, but I personally don’t like it. Other than the smell, the product itself works well and feels good on my skin.

avis.titre: The product itself seemed to work fine.
avis.texte: I didn’t like that the container fell apart one day when I pressed down on the pump. I did like the texture and effectiveness of the product.

avis.titre: The dispenser is  dispenser is horrible!  The pump was inconsistent and then the bottle broke
avis.texte: I like the product but the pump was inconsistent after a few uses Then the bottle broke. I am working through it because I don’t want to waste the product and I paid good $$ for it. But I most likely will not buy this again. If I bought it locally, I would be returning it for an exchange, but because it was online, it’s just a huge inconvenience There are many products similar to this out there so I will be trying something else

I struggle to get sunscreen that works on dark skin that's not super expensive -- Super Goop or filled with oils that clog my pores. No white cast! Will give you a bit of shine. This is great for all nationalities and skin types. I don't wear a lot of makeup.

Love it! It’s an all in one tinted moisturizer perfect for getting ready fast, when you’re just at home, or just want minimal coverage. The thing that I like most about this tinted moisturizer is the glow it leaves on your face. I was curious as to how this one color for all tinted moisturizer would look on my skin. I was amazed at how the color blended into your skin. Other things I love about it—the high SPF coverage and the anti aging elements. This is a product that will likely become a staple in my skincare routine.

So sad I missed my return window. I wish it could have been replaced so I could try it but I am not going to risk buying another. I am just happy I went to try it for a skin sensitivity test before I left for my vacation! EDIT: They did work with me and gave me a full refund even though I missed the return window. I will try ordering again because the product itself is great.
So far so good. I have used this once. It feels good on. Leaves my skin glowy. I have used it over my moisturizer but not under any makeup yet. Comes in a nice cute bottle.

So I order this product frequently. But recently the packaging has been literally crumbling in my hands. My past two bottles actually broke in half. I love this product. I have sensitive skin and my skin has never looked better. It actually blended in with my pale complexion. Please just fix the package Deformities. Thank you!

I LOVE this product! It provides natural coverage with a beautiful GLOW and it’s weightless with SPF 46! I love this and will buy it again and again!

I love this product gives my face a nice shine! I love the tint matches my complexion. It is a good sun screen protector!

avis.titre: Not as big as the hype

avis.titre: Very light and natural looking,  LOVE IT ❤️

avis.titre: Light not greasy, just a soft sun kissed glow

avis.titre: Great for sensitive skin and evening skin tone

This is crazy! I picked up my bottle to get ready for the day. I pressed the pump ---1 time!!!! Just once and next thing I know it's shooting off and busting..... crazy! I have only used this bottle for 2 applications until today.

My skin looks the same before and after I apply this, but it probably does even some stuff out. I wipe it off at the end of the day and there is color on the cotton pad, so it must be doing something cosmetically. It does not make my skin oily or breakout whatsoever. I have nothing to compare this to, but it works extremely well with my skin and just fine on top of my regular simple routine. My true reason for ending up buying it was for the SPF, and it is a fantastic facial SPF product. I feel like I'll maybe be using this in the future, but it hasn't changed my life or anything. I use isntree sunscreen and I'm perfectly happy with that for SPF for a similar price.
